hints.title: Greedy Profit Foundation
hints.text: Sort all items by profit in descending order and select the top k items initially to maximize total profit.

hints.title: Tracking Duplicate Categories
hints.text: Maintain a stack of profit values for items whose category has appeared more than once in the initial k elements.

hints.title: Category Expansion Swap
hints.text: Iterate through the remaining items. Whenever a new distinct category appears, consider replacing the smallest duplicate profit item from the stack.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting items by profit followed by greedy replacement of duplicate categories.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all combinations of k items is exponential in n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for the duplicate profit stack and visited category set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply greedy replacement using a stack to preserve optimal balance between base profit and category square bonus.
